package.name: go2_description
package.description: Unitree Go2 quadruped robot description for ROS 2 and Gazebo Sim. URDF (urdf/go2.urdf) and CAD meshes (dae/) are derived from the Unitree Robotics go2_description package (BSD-3-Clause, see LICENSE/NOTICE), adapted for ROS 2 with Gazebo Sim native sensor/system extensions.
